observations: body L1, L2: the three points stand at the left of «موضع», at the end of the Arabic run; the quotation goes on in L2 («موزون السطح»).
body L2, L18: «ليكُنْ» (L2) and «وسط» in «المَمَرُّ في وسط السماء» (L18) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.
body L2: «سطحُهُ» has the ḍamma on the ḥāʾ and on the hāʾ.
body L8, L9, L15: «السَّمَاءَ» has the fatḥa over the hamza in L8 and L9; «السَّمَاءِ» (L15) has the kasra under it.
body L18, L20, L21: «المَمَرُّ», «الجَنُوبيُّ» and «العَشَوِيُّ» end with the shadda and the ḍamma; «الجَنُوبيُّ» has no kasra under the bāʾ.
body L12, L19: «v.» (vide) before «تشريق» is the Latin v, as in «vel» (L12), not the Arabic figure ٧.
body L26: the em dash after «وسع» is broken near its left end (1.6 and 7.1 points). «المَشْرقِ» has the fatḥa on the mīm, the sukun on the shīn and the kasra under the qāf, none under the rāʾ.
body L28: «٣٤» is a 3 joined to a 4 (8.4 points wide; a joined «٢٤» measures about 6.6).
body L32, L33: «الٱتِّصَالَاتُ» (L32) has the waṣla over the alif after the article; «الاجتمَاعات» (L33) has only the fatḥa on the mīm.
body L6, L7: «Edr.» and «Auw.» are not letter-spaced (letter gaps 0.8-1.3 points; «Dozy», L6, 1.8-2.0).
notes_left L1, L4: the hyphen of «Bouché-Leclercq» (L1) is 3.8 points long; that of «σω-» (L4) 2.9 points, the en dashes of the notes on pp. 333 and 343 4.3-4.7 points.
notes_right L3: the three points follow the comma of «astres,» without a space.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
